blocks.text: MicroGram turns YouTube videos and playlists into reels of the duration you choose. Watch a lecture one reel at a time.
Capture a frame, add a label or a note, and find your screenshots organized into albums by video in your Screen Notes Library.
YouTube lectures. The reel experience you already know.
Add a YouTube video or a whole playlist.
Learn in short reels. See each small step add up.
Save a reel, write a note or capture a frame.
What if your scrolling addiction could actually help you complete your lectures?
If sitting through long lectures feels like a struggle, you're not alone. Sometimes, getting started and staying engaged is harder than the learning itself.
Turn your scrolling habit into learning time.
Use the familiar swipe-to-next experience to move through lectures in short, focused reels, making it easier to keep learning one step at a time.
Stay engaged with your lectures, one reel at a time.
The dopamine-driven reward behind every swipe is what makes reels so addictive. MicroGram redirects that same reward towards learning, making every swipe feel like progress.
Skip the manual note-taking. Capture what matters.
Pause, capture a frame, add a label or a note, and save it. Find every capture organized by video in your Screen Notes Library, ready to revisit.
